title: Anthropic Develops FlashProve to Verify AI Model Identity
excerpt: Anthropic is building a system named FlashProve that allows users to verify the true identity behind an artificial intelligence response.
body_html:
Anthropic is currently developing a new system designed to verify the identity of artificial intelligence models. The project, named FlashProve, is intended to allow anyone to check whether a specific AI response genuinely originated from the model it claims to be from.

As artificial intelligence technology continues to evolve and see widespread deployment, verifying the origin of generated outputs has become increasingly relevant. With FlashProve, users would have a mechanism to confirm the authenticity of model responses, ensuring transparency regarding which AI system produced a given output.

Further details regarding the technical implementation, launch timeline, or availability of FlashProve have not yet been disclosed by Anthropic.
